== bau lo spano ==
* There is now a [http://www.lojban.org/lists/lojban-es/ Spanish Lojban mailing list], which you can sign up for using [http://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/lojban the mailing list web interface].
* [http://www.lojban.org/publications/brochures/brochure_espanol.txt Spanish Brochure]
*Spanish cmavo and gismu definitions are in [http://jbovlaste.lojban.org jbovlaste].
* The gismu list was translated into [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/gismu_spanish.txt Spanish]

== bau lo xebro ==
*There is a partial [[Hebrew gismu List|Hebrew gismu List]]

==  Other ways of contacting the community ==
* For speakers of other languages just ask on the [http://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/lojban Lojban mailing list].
* Note that [http://www.lojban.org/jbovlaste the Lojban dictionary] has translations of many languages in it.
* See also the [[ongoing projects|ongoing projects list]] on the Wiki for some LLG-independent translation projects people are working on.
